Ravi (Security): Legal flagged a potential data-exfil incident. They want auth + proxy logs preserved for 180d for forensics, but we can't change global retention. Thoughts on scoped holds?
Maya (SRE): Scoped hold is doable: copy matching objects to a hold bucket with S3 Object Lock (GOVERNANCE) + CMK. Tag with legal_hold_id.
Lina (Infra): For SIEM exports: do NOT broaden export-service principal. Create a one-off export job that writes only to s3://redwood-hold/LegalHold-2026-07-15/ and restrict PutObject to that path.
Priya (Legal): Tag must be LegalHold-2026-07-15 and include case=CASE-742. We require a scrubbed copy (PII removed) and a custody manifest with SHA256s.
Ravi (Security): Can we make ephemeral read role for Legal with 180d TTL and require session tags reason=LegalHold-2026-07-15 ticket=CASE-742?
Lina (Infra): Yes. Role: ephemeral_legal_reader_CASE742. Policy: s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::redwood-hold/LegalHold-2026-07-15/*, CloudTrail read. Trust via STS AssumeRole with external_id=CASE-742. We'll create a KMS grant for decrypt scoped to the hold CMK and expire the grant in 180d.
Maya (SRE): Playbook snippet:
```
# create bucket path
aws s3api put-object --bucket redwood-hold --key LegalHold-2026-07-15/. --tagging "legal_hold_id=LegalHold-2026-07-15&case=CASE-742"
# splunk -> s3 export
splunk search "index=auth OR index=proxy earliest=-7d@d latest=@d" | splunk export s3 --bucket redwood-hold --prefix LegalHold-2026-07-15/ --format ndjson
# set object lock and metadata
aws s3api put-object-retention --bucket redwood-hold --key LegalHold-2026-07-15/ --retention "{\"Mode\":\"GOVERNANCE\",\"RetainUntilDate\":\"2027-01-01T00:00:00Z\"}"
```
Priya (Legal): Confirm scrub pipeline will redact query_params and mask IPs. We'll only accept access after scrubbed copies + manifest are attached.
OpsBot: [automated] playbook: /playbooks/log-preservation -> tasks created: create_hold_dir, scoped_export, set_object_lock, run_scrub, attach_manifest, create_ephemeral_role.
Ravi (Security): Action items: Lina prepare Terraform + KMS grant, Maya run export and scrub, Priya will validate redaction. I'll file SEC-742 and link this thread. :thumbsup:
